pages.title: Color in Motion
pages.text: Most Aura follows the common weight and flow. Black travels vertically only; Orange travels horizontally only and can set nearby nodes into a current.

pages.title: White
pages.text: White follows the ordinary weight and ascent rules, and keeps its charge between passive ticks.

pages.title: Black
pages.text: Black has zero effective weight. It travels vertically only, cannot be lifted by a pump, and does not generate power as it falls.

pages.title: Orange
pages.text: Orange has zero effective weight and travels horizontally only. Its transfer induces current in nearby Aura Nodes along that direction.

pages.title: Red
pages.text: Red Aura catches TNT within three blocks just before it bursts and Creepers at the brink of detonation. TNT lends a 200,000 Aura lift budget; each Creeper lends 50,000. Linked nodes above divide the budget by their rise, capped by the source node's stored Red Aura. The explosion effect is visual only.

pages.title: Yellow
pages.text: Yellow doubles its ascent boost, then loses stored charge during passive ticks.

pages.title: Green
pages.text: Green weighs twice the usual amount by day and half as much at night, changing its lift and falling-power balance.

pages.title: Blue
pages.text: Rain gives Blue a fourfold ascent boost; in dry weather its ascent factor falls to one half.

pages.title: Violet
pages.text: Violet grows in node storage, faster from smaller reserves. It dissipates at 25 or less and clears above 2,600.
